<quote by="Proposed: Ossium, Seconded: Volodmartz">To upgrade the Bone Hives. To both improve the structures of the hives and to provide the Amber Scorpion, who work the hives, with housing. Total cost is 26 weirwood and <s>52</s> 78 crowns.</quote>
==Overview==
* Expands the [[Keeper_of_the_Bonehives#The_Bone_Hives|Bone Hives]] as per the '''[[Thousands_or_more#Secrets_of_the_Bonehives|Thousands or more]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed

==Date==
* Autumn 386YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 26 weirwood
* 78 crowns
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Expand_the_Bone_Hives}}
==Outcome==
Now complete the [[Keeper of the Bonehives]] receives an additional dose each season of ''Flickerbright'', ''Stormspark'', and ''Fireheart''. They have also gained access to a ministry to allow them to purchase additional doses of the substances, and give them access to the rare ''Slumbersting''.
